article.title: Factors to be taken into account by the adjudicating officer.
article.html:
47Factors to be taken into account by the adjudicating officer.

Section 47 · Chapter IX · page 21 of the Act

While adjudging the quantum of compensation under this Chapter, the adjudicating officer shall have due regard to the following factors, namely:–

(a) the amount of gain of unfair advantage, wherever quantifiable, made as a result of the default;

(b) the amount of loss caused to any person as a result of the default;

(c) the repetitive nature of the default.
